calls.title: Website pricing page table
calls.summary: The team discussed improving the pricing page structure to align features with the corresponding plans, aiming to clarify misgrouped items. Major points included separating features like experiment guardrails from auto rollback, cleanup of category inconsistencies, and defining a tiered data pipeline ownership model based on plans. Approval workflows for experimentation and metrics were highlighted as a security enhancement, noting that these systems have yet to be implemented. Additionally, they outlined specific AI feature usage limits tied to different plans and discussed reorganizing performance features to better reflect their functionalities. A strong emphasis was placed on effective SEO tactics and improving user clarity in these categories.
calls.keywords: pricing page, experiment features, data pipeline, AI usage limits, approval workflows, dashboard sharing
